ASTRA — NORTH-STAR RESEARCH DOSSIER
5 November 2026. Research record, not a manuscript.

OUTCOME

The north star was not achieved. No new usable quantum memory, autonomous
quantum-computing threshold, device or matched technological advantage was
established. Exactly three independent gpt-6.1-sol/max researchers worked
alongside the principal. No additional researchers were spawned. Initial
constructions preceded exchange; competing constructions were then challenged.
After the user's redirection, all four attacked hard quantum-hardware gaps.

The strongest positive opening identified is a fault-tolerant bridge from
reliable asynchronous classical control to continuously running quantum
correction with noisy clocks, ancillas and general local noise. Synchronous
autonomous quantum correction is already a strong incumbent. The missing
theorem concerns quantum causal frontiers and protected idle periods through
controller reconstruction, with a joint diamond-norm fault induction.

A concrete part was proved: a bounded local quantum-service module with
atomic ownership, short leases, deadline completion and sparse fixed-box
witnesses for service failures, including adaptive request starts. This closes
a service-counting gap. It does not close the full quantum hierarchy.

The strongest negative result is an arbitrary-encoding/decoder bound for an
exact fully secular thermal generator. Established spectral-genericity machinery
makes it applicable to almost every arbitrarily weak perturbation in specified
local directions. It exposes a bath-model/order-of-limits obstruction; it is
not a physical impossibility theorem for quantum storage.

The earlier Gibbs dossier remains unchanged in RESEARCH_DOSSIER.txt and
RESEARCH_RECORD.zip. Its bilayer and single-spin constructions remain separate.
Gibbs uniqueness is not being equated with dynamical stationarity, efficient
preparation, or quantum memory.

1. THE HARD TARGET AND THE ACTUAL MISSING OPERATION

Desired capability: fixed local time-independent driven/dissipative dynamics
in 2D or 3D, finite site dimension/density/range/rates, preserving unknown
encoded quantum information for exp(c L^a) time under nonzero local noise on
data AND controllers/ancillas. No perfect global clock or noiseless decoder
operates during storage. Driven resets consume power and export entropy;
